meeting.flac.reference: Good morning everyone, let's start with the budget review. Priya, can you share the numbers from last quarter? Sure, revenue was up twelve percent and costs stayed flat. Great. The main open item is the contract with the shipping vendor. Legal still needs to review the termination clause. Marcus, please send the draft to Legal by Wednesday. Elena will update the customer forecast before the next meeting. Let's meet again on Tuesday at ten to make a final decision.
